# TDPdf v2.1.1.1

**Fix: what you set in your printer's Properties dialog prints again.**

## Printing

- Since 2.1.0.0, most settings chosen under **Properties…** in the print window were lost when the dialog closed: stapling, hole punch, folding, output tray, collation, secure-print PINs, account codes and the printer maker's own finishing options. Reopening the dialog also showed the printer's defaults instead of what you had picked. Those settings now reach the printer again.
- Two-sided printing chosen in that dialog, fixed in 2.1.0.0, still works.

## Installing

Managed machines update through Intune automatically; nothing to do. Otherwise it's the same self-contained `TDPdf.exe`.
